lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region; inter-blob distance is approximately uniform within columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular centroids, forming an observable lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp luminance transition (high-intensity pixels on top, low-intensity shadow pixels below) running longitudinally along the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of small-diameter, high-luminance blobs on the visible dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
